scope: apps/web/src consumer points minus components/ui/ (#1054/#1055, ADR 0012 D1). Two ledgers in one review face. squareBoxes: every line the shape gate flags (visible square box: bare rounded-none + unconditional paint, or enclosing border + fill with no radius declared) must match an entry {file, anchor, kind, basis?, reason} — anchor = literal substring of the flagged line. kind deviation = deliberate non-registry geometry with reason; kind rides-primitive = radius comes through from the underlying registry component (basis names it); kind state-surface = state tint painted over an already-ruled box (line-level scan cannot see the base class). brandInkText: every consumer text-role use of the brand ink (--card-button/--focus-ring as text-(...) or CSS color:) must match an entry {file, anchor, role, reason, contrast} — role in selection-mark | indicator | badge-glyph | action-link (#987: brand ink is spot emphasis only, never body/label/button-text ink; action-link = the board card accent text link, DESIGN.md 按钮). Solid-fill (bg-) uses are the slot's canonical role and are not policed. Full disposition inventory incl. wave-1 attribution: docs/spec/27-消费点形状与品牌墨台账.md.

squareBoxes.reason: #1008 user-reviewed sweep (d93f9709): the rounded-none override was removed from MENU_SHELL_CLS; the radius shows through from the primitive base (ADR 0012 D1). Border+bg on the consumer line with no rounded class = riding, not square.
#1008 user-reviewed sweep: SELECT_TRIGGER_CLS override removed, radius rides the Button base (comment on the constant records the ruling).
